item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 2.8: what the extra training changed
item.description: The run is done. Gemma translates better, including Latin Dhivehi. Its meaning tests and internal probes tell a messier story.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 2.7: an idea to try next
item.description: Gemma mistook fish for month. Changing its internal state changed the prediction. Training helped a little; forcing Thaana output broke the answers. Now I want to find which smaller parts caused those effects.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 2.6: a little progress
item.description: The pretrained model gets better at predicting held-out Dhivehi. Reading its continuations shows how much is still missing.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 2.5: better Dhivehi prose
item.description: M1c tests continued pretraining on chat-tuned Gemma. The prose improves. Next: start from the pretrained checkpoint’s stronger Dhivehi reading, then use it to help post-train the chat model.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 2: write it in Thaana first
item.description: Gemma 4 can read Thaana but not Dhivehi typed in Latin letters. Making it rewrite each message in Thaana first gets it the gist of 87% of held-out chat messages, close to Gemini Flash's 91.5%.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 1.6: quick update
item.description: Fifteen minutes of alignment, no replies trained. Gemma used to call Latin-typed Dhivehi Chakma and loop; now it sometimes gets the meaning, and answers in Sinhala.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 1.5: the model already knew
item.description: The pretrained model already reads Dhivehi, chat training damaged it, and the data that exists for Dhivehi teaches the exact failure fine-tuning kept producing.

item.title: Where does Gemma keep Dhivehi? Part 1
item.description: A model can understand a language in one script and not in another. Probing Gemma 4 for Thaana, Latin-script Dhivehi, and a fish that might be a month.

item.title: What did Gemma learn instead?
item.description: A model can recognize a problem and keep going. Arithmetic experiments, conflicting model judges, and the Hugging Face incident.
